def tailRow (d : MediumAtom) (H : ℝ) (p m : ℕ) : ℂ :=
  ∑ n ∈ d.cleanedCommonPProgression p m,
    ∑ r ∈ factorCarrier d.Q2, ∑ s ∈ factorCarrier d.Q3,
      if Int.ModEq (p * r * s) ((m : ℤ) * n) d.residue ∧
          H < (fouvryTau 4 (CommonPM2FiniteFold.shiftDifference d (m * n)) : ℝ)
      then d.gamma2 r * d.gamma3 s * d.cleanedAlphaAtom.transposedAtom.beta n
      else 0

def keptProgressionRow (d : MediumAtom) (H : ℝ) (p m : ℕ) : ℂ :=
  ∑ n ∈ d.cleanedCommonPProgression p m,
    ∑ r ∈ factorCarrier d.Q2, ∑ s ∈ factorCarrier d.Q3,
      if Int.ModEq (p * r * s) ((m : ℤ) * n) d.residue ∧
          (fouvryTau 4 (CommonPM2FiniteFold.shiftDifference d (m * n)) : ℝ) ≤ H
      then d.gamma2 r * d.gamma3 s * d.cleanedAlphaAtom.transposedAtom.beta n
      else 0

def truncatedCenteredRow (d : MediumAtom) (H : ℝ) (p m : ℕ) : ℂ :=
  keptProgressionRow d H p m -
    (d.cleanedAlphaAtom.q1SliceAtom p).transposedAtom.complexPrincipalRow m

private theorem full_modEq_imp_common (p r s m n : ℕ) (a : ℤ)
    (h : Int.ModEq (p * r * s) ((m : ℤ) * n) a) :
    Int.ModEq p ((m : ℤ) * n) a := by
  apply Int.ModEq.of_dvd (show (p : ℤ) ∣ (p : ℤ) * r * s from ?_) h
  exact ⟨(r : ℤ) * s, by ring⟩

private theorem sliced_progression_expansion (d : MediumAtom) {p : ℕ}
    (hp : p ∈ factorCarrier d.Q1) (m : ℕ) :
    (d.cleanedAlphaAtom.q1SliceAtom p).transposedAtom.complexProgressionRow m =
      ∑ n ∈ d.cleanedAlphaAtom.transposedAtom.betaCarrier,
        ∑ r ∈ factorCarrier d.Q2, ∑ s ∈ factorCarrier d.Q3,
          if Int.ModEq (p * r * s) ((m : ℤ) * n) d.residue
          then d.gamma2 r * d.gamma3 s * d.cleanedAlphaAtom.transposedAtom.beta n
          else 0 := by
  unfold MediumAtom.complexProgressionRow
  simp only [MediumAtom.complexRowLabels, MediumAtom.complexFactorLabels,
    Finset.sum_product, MediumAtom.complexFactorGamma, complexFactorModulus,
    Nat.cast_mul]
  change (∑ q ∈ factorCarrier d.Q1, ∑ r ∈ factorCarrier d.Q2,
    ∑ s ∈ factorCarrier d.Q3, ∑ n ∈ d.cleanedAlphaAtom.transposedAtom.betaCarrier,
      ((if q = p then (1 : ℂ) else 0) * d.gamma2 r * d.gamma3 s *
        d.cleanedAlphaAtom.transposedAtom.beta n) *
        (if Int.ModEq (q * r * s) ((m : ℤ) * n) d.residue then 1 else 0)) = _
  rw [Finset.sum_eq_single p]
  · simp only [if_pos rfl, one_mul]
    simp_rw [Finset.sum_comm (s := factorCarrier d.Q3)
      (t := d.cleanedAlphaAtom.transposedAtom.betaCarrier)]
    rw [Finset.sum_comm]
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro n _hn
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro r _hr
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro s _hs
    split_ifs <;> simp
  · intro q _hq hqp
    simp only [if_neg hqp, zero_mul, Finset.sum_const_zero]
  · intro hnot
    exact (hnot hp).elim

private theorem progression_eq_common_row (d : MediumAtom) {p : ℕ}
    (hp : p ∈ factorCarrier d.Q1) (m : ℕ) :
    (d.cleanedAlphaAtom.q1SliceAtom p).transposedAtom.complexProgressionRow m =
      ∑ n ∈ d.cleanedCommonPProgression p m,
        ∑ r ∈ factorCarrier d.Q2, ∑ s ∈ factorCarrier d.Q3,
          if Int.ModEq (p * r * s) ((m : ℤ) * n) d.residue
          then d.gamma2 r * d.gamma3 s * d.cleanedAlphaAtom.transposedAtom.beta n
          else 0 := by
  rw [sliced_progression_expansion d hp m]
  symm
  apply Finset.sum_subset (Finset.filter_subset _ _)
  intro n hn hnnot
  by_cases hdiv : (n : ℤ) ∣ d.residue
  · have hb : d.cleanedAlphaAtom.transposedAtom.beta n = 0 := by
      change (if n ∈ d.alphaCarrier then d.cleanedAlpha n else 0) = 0
      simp only [MediumAtom.cleanedAlpha, if_pos hdiv, ite_self]
    simp only [hb, mul_zero, ite_self, Finset.sum_const_zero]
  · have hmod : ¬Int.ModEq p ((m : ℤ) * n) d.residue := by
      intro h
      exact hnnot (Finset.mem_filter.mpr ⟨hn, hdiv, h⟩)
    apply Finset.sum_eq_zero
    intro r _hr
    apply Finset.sum_eq_zero
    intro s _hs
    exact if_neg (fun h => hmod (full_modEq_imp_common p r s m n d.residue h))

private theorem absolute_row_eq_fibers (d : MediumAtom) (m n : ℕ) :
    d.absoluteFactorModulusRow m n = ∑ q ∈ d.physicalFactorModuli,
      if Int.ModEq q ((m : ℤ) * n) d.residue then d.absoluteFactorFiber q else 0 := by
  unfold MediumAtom.absoluteFactorModulusRow
  rw [← Finset.sum_fiberwise_of_maps_to
    (s := d.complexFactorLabels) (t := d.physicalFactorModuli)
    (g := complexFactorModulus) (fun r hr => Finset.mem_image_of_mem _ hr)]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro q _hq
  by_cases hq : Int.ModEq q ((m : ℤ) * n) d.residue
  · rw [if_pos hq]
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro r hr
    simp only [(Finset.mem_filter.mp hr).2, if_pos hq]
  · rw [if_neg hq]
    apply Finset.sum_eq_zero
    intro r hr
    simp only [(Finset.mem_filter.mp hr).2, if_neg hq]

private theorem absolute_row_le_tauFour_of_ne
    {B : ℕ} {sigma kappa c0 : ℝ} {d : MediumAtom}
    (hd : MediumAdmissible B sigma kappa c0 d) (m n : ℕ)
    (hne : (m : ℤ) * n - d.residue ≠ 0) :
    d.absoluteFactorModulusRow m n ≤
      (fouvryTau 4 (((m : ℤ) * n - d.residue).natAbs) : ℝ) := by
  rw [absolute_row_eq_fibers]
  calc
    _ ≤ ∑ q ∈ d.physicalFactorModuli,
        if Int.ModEq q ((m : ℤ) * n) d.residue then (fouvryTau 3 q : ℝ) else 0 := by
      apply Finset.sum_le_sum
      intro q _hq
      split_ifs
      · exact d.absoluteFactorFiber_le_tauThree hd q
      · exact le_rfl
    _ = ∑ q ∈ d.physicalFactorModuli.filter
        (fun q : ℕ => Int.ModEq q ((m : ℤ) * n) d.residue), (fouvryTau 3 q : ℝ) := by
      rw [Finset.sum_filter]
    _ ≤ ∑ q ∈ (((m : ℤ) * n - d.residue).natAbs).divisors,
        (fouvryTau 3 q : ℝ) := by
      apply Finset.sum_le_sum_of_subset_of_nonneg
      · intro q hq
        have he := (Finset.mem_filter.mp hq).2
        apply Nat.mem_divisors.mpr
        refine ⟨?_, Int.natAbs_ne_zero.mpr hne⟩
        have hdiv : (q : ℤ) ∣ (m : ℤ) * n - d.residue :=
          Int.modEq_iff_dvd.mp he.symm
        exact_mod_cast Int.natAbs_dvd_natAbs.mpr hdiv
      · intro _ _ _
        positivity
    _ = _ := by rw [show 4 = 3 + 1 from rfl, fouvryTau_succ, Nat.cast_sum]

private theorem slice_absolute_row_eq_pair (d : MediumAtom) {p : ℕ}
    (hp : p ∈ factorCarrier d.Q1) (m n : ℕ) :
    (d.q1SliceAtom p).absoluteFactorModulusRow m n =
      ∑ r ∈ factorCarrier d.Q2, ∑ s ∈ factorCarrier d.Q3,
        if Int.ModEq (p * r * s) ((m : ℤ) * n) d.residue
        then ‖d.gamma2 r * d.gamma3 s‖ else 0 := by
  unfold MediumAtom.absoluteFactorModulusRow
  simp only [MediumAtom.complexFactorLabels, Finset.sum_product,
    MediumAtom.complexFactorGamma, complexFactorModulus, Nat.cast_mul]
  change (∑ q ∈ factorCarrier d.Q1, ∑ r ∈ factorCarrier d.Q2,
    ∑ s ∈ factorCarrier d.Q3,
      if Int.ModEq (q * r * s) ((m : ℤ) * n) d.residue
      then ‖(if q = p then (1 : ℂ) else 0) * d.gamma2 r * d.gamma3 s‖ else 0) = _
  rw [Finset.sum_eq_single p]
  · simp only [if_pos rfl, one_mul]
  · intro q _hq hqp
    simp only [if_neg hqp, zero_mul, norm_zero, ite_self, Finset.sum_const_zero]
  · intro hnot
    exact (hnot hp).elim

private theorem inner_tail_norm_le
    {B : ℕ} {sigma kappa c0 : ℝ} {d : MediumAtom}
    (hd : MediumAdmissible B sigma kappa c0 d) {H : ℝ} (hH : 0 < H)
    {p : ℕ} (hp : p ∈ d.primitiveFirstFactorCarrier) (m n : ℕ)
    (hn : n ∈ d.cleanedCommonPProgression p m) :
    ‖∑ r ∈ factorCarrier d.Q2, ∑ s ∈ factorCarrier d.Q3,
      if Int.ModEq (p * r * s) ((m : ℤ) * n) d.residue ∧
          H < (fouvryTau 4 (CommonPM2FiniteFold.shiftDifference d (m * n)) : ℝ)
      then d.gamma2 r * d.gamma3 s * d.cleanedAlphaAtom.transposedAtom.beta n else 0‖ ≤
      ‖d.cleanedAlphaAtom.transposedAtom.beta n‖ *
        (fouvryTau 4 (CommonPM2FiniteFold.shiftDifference d (m * n)) : ℝ) ^ 2 / H := by
  let T : ℝ := (fouvryTau 4 (CommonPM2FiniteFold.shiftDifference d (m * n)) : ℝ)
  have hT : 0 ≤ T := Nat.cast_nonneg _
  have hne : (m : ℤ) * n - d.residue ≠ 0 := by
    intro he
    exact (Finset.mem_filter.mp hn).2.1 ⟨(m : ℤ), by nlinarith⟩
  have hmass : (∑ r ∈ factorCarrier d.Q2, ∑ s ∈ factorCarrier d.Q3,
      if Int.ModEq (p * r * s) ((m : ℤ) * n) d.residue
      then ‖d.gamma2 r * d.gamma3 s‖ else 0) ≤ T := by
    have hh := absolute_row_le_tauFour_of_ne (mediumAdmissible_q1SliceAtom hd hp) m n hne
    rw [slice_absolute_row_eq_pair d (Finset.mem_filter.mp hp).1 m n] at hh
    simpa only [MediumAtom.q1SliceAtom, CommonPM2FiniteFold.shiftDifference, Nat.cast_mul] using hh
  by_cases hcut : H < T
  · have hpay : T ≤ T ^ 2 / H := by
      apply (le_div_iff₀ hH).mpr
      simpa only [pow_two] using mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hcut.le hT
    calc
      _ ≤ ∑ r ∈ factorCarrier d.Q2, ∑ s ∈ factorCarrier d.Q3,
          if Int.ModEq (p * r * s) ((m : ℤ) * n) d.residue
          then ‖d.gamma2 r * d.gamma3 s‖ * ‖d.cleanedAlphaAtom.transposedAtom.beta n‖ else 0 := by
        apply (norm_sum_le _ _).trans
        apply Finset.sum_le_sum
        intro r _hr
        apply (norm_sum_le _ _).trans
        apply Finset.sum_le_sum
        intro s _hs
        by_cases hmod : Int.ModEq (p * r * s) ((m : ℤ) * n) d.residue
        · simp only [show H < (fouvryTau 4 (CommonPM2FiniteFold.shiftDifference d (m * n)) : ℝ)
            from hcut, hmod, and_self, if_pos, norm_mul, le_refl]
        · simp only [hmod, false_and, if_false, norm_zero, le_refl]
      _ = (∑ r ∈ factorCarrier d.Q2, ∑ s ∈ factorCarrier d.Q3,
          if Int.ModEq (p * r * s) ((m : ℤ) * n) d.residue
          then ‖d.gamma2 r * d.gamma3 s‖ else 0) *
            ‖d.cleanedAlphaAtom.transposedAtom.beta n‖ := by
        simp only [Finset.sum_mul, ite_mul, zero_mul]
      _ ≤ T * ‖d.cleanedAlphaAtom.transposedAtom.beta n‖ :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hmass (norm_nonneg _)
      _ ≤ (T ^ 2 / H) * ‖d.cleanedAlphaAtom.transposedAtom.beta n‖ :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hpay (norm_nonneg _)
      _ = _ := by dsimp [T]; ring
  · have hzero : ∀ r s : ℕ,
        (if Int.ModEq (p * r * s) ((m : ℤ) * n) d.residue ∧
          H < (fouvryTau 4 (CommonPM2FiniteFold.shiftDifference d (m * n)) : ℝ)
        then d.gamma2 r * d.gamma3 s * d.cleanedAlphaAtom.transposedAtom.beta n else 0) = 0 := by
      intro r s
      exact if_neg (fun h => hcut h.2)
    simp only [hzero, Finset.sum_const_zero, norm_zero]
    exact div_nonneg (mul_nonneg (norm_nonneg _) (sq_nonneg _)) hH.le

theorem centeredRow_sub_truncated_eq_tail
    {B : ℕ} {sigma kappa c0 : ℝ} {d : MediumAtom}
    (hd : MediumAdmissible B sigma kappa c0 d)
    (H : ℝ) {p : ℕ} (hp : p ∈ d.primitiveFirstFactorCarrier) (m : ℕ) :
    (d.cleanedAlphaAtom.q1SliceAtom p).transposedAtom.complexCenteredRow m -
      truncatedCenteredRow d H p m = tailRow d H p m := by
  by_cases hpzero : p = 0
  · have hlo := (Finset.mem_Icc.mp (Finset.mem_filter.mp hp).1).1
    have hceil : 1 ≤ Nat.ceil d.Q1 := by
      exact_mod_cast hd.2.2.1.trans (Nat.le_ceil d.Q1)
    omega
  · have hsplit :
        (d.cleanedAlphaAtom.q1SliceAtom p).transposedAtom.complexProgressionRow m =
          keptProgressionRow d H p m + tailRow d H p m := by
      rw [progression_eq_common_row d (Finset.mem_filter.mp hp).1 m]
      unfold keptProgressionRow tailRow
      rw [← Finset.sum_add_distrib]
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro n _hn
      rw [← Finset.sum_add_distrib]
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro r _hr
      rw [← Finset.sum_add_distrib]
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro s _hs
      by_cases hmod : Int.ModEq (p * r * s) ((m : ℤ) * n) d.residue
      · by_cases hcut : (fouvryTau 4 (CommonPM2FiniteFold.shiftDifference d (m * n)) : ℝ) ≤ H
        · simp only [hmod, hcut, not_lt_of_ge hcut, and_true, and_false,
            if_true, if_false, add_zero]
        · have hgt : H < (fouvryTau 4 (CommonPM2FiniteFold.shiftDifference d (m * n)) : ℝ) :=
            lt_of_not_ge hcut
          simp only [hmod, hcut, hgt, and_true, and_false, if_true, if_false, zero_add]
      · simp only [hmod, false_and, if_false, add_zero]
    unfold MediumAtom.complexCenteredRow truncatedCenteredRow
    rw [hsplit]
    ring

theorem tailRow_norm_le
    {B : ℕ} {sigma kappa c0 : ℝ} {d : MediumAtom}
    (hd : MediumAdmissible B sigma kappa c0 d)
    {H : ℝ} (hH : 0 < H)
    {p : ℕ} (hp : p ∈ d.primitiveFirstFactorCarrier) (m : ℕ) :
    ‖tailRow d H p m‖ ≤ CommonPM2FiniteFold.rowSum d p m / H := by
  unfold tailRow CommonPM2FiniteFold.rowSum
  apply (norm_sum_le _ _).trans
  calc
    _ ≤ ∑ n ∈ d.cleanedCommonPProgression p m,
        ‖d.cleanedAlphaAtom.transposedAtom.beta n‖ *
          (fouvryTau 4 (CommonPM2FiniteFold.shiftDifference d (m * n)) : ℝ) ^ 2 / H :=
      Finset.sum_le_sum (fun n hn => inner_tail_norm_le hd hH hp m n hn)
    _ = _ := by rw [Finset.sum_div]

theorem centered_tail_energy_le_M2
    {B : ℕ} {sigma kappa c0 : ℝ} {d : MediumAtom}
    (hd : MediumAdmissible B sigma kappa c0 d)
    {H : ℝ} (hH : 0 < H) :
    CommonPM2FiniteFold.outsideEnergy d *
      (∑ p ∈ d.primitiveFirstFactorCarrier,
        ∑ m ∈ d.cleanedAlphaAtom.transposedAtom.commonSmoothCarrier,
          d.cleanedAlphaAtom.transposedAtom.commonSmoothWeight m *
            ‖(d.cleanedAlphaAtom.q1SliceAtom p).transposedAtom.complexCenteredRow m -
              truncatedCenteredRow d H p m‖ ^ 2) ≤
      (CommonPM2FiniteFold.outsideEnergy d *
        CommonPM2FiniteFold.moment d) / H ^ 2 := by
  have hE : 0 ≤ CommonPM2FiniteFold.outsideEnergy d := by
    unfold CommonPM2FiniteFold.outsideEnergy
    exact mul_nonneg (Finset.sum_nonneg (fun _ _ => sq_nonneg _))
      (Finset.sum_nonneg (fun _ _ => sq_nonneg _))
  calc
    _ ≤ CommonPM2FiniteFold.outsideEnergy d *
        (∑ p ∈ d.primitiveFirstFactorCarrier,
          ∑ m ∈ d.cleanedAlphaAtom.transposedAtom.commonSmoothCarrier,
            d.cleanedAlphaAtom.transposedAtom.commonSmoothWeight m *
              (CommonPM2FiniteFold.rowSum d p m ^ 2 / H ^ 2)) := by
      apply mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left _ hE
      apply Finset.sum_le_sum
      intro p hp
      apply Finset.sum_le_sum
      intro m _hm
      apply mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left _
        (d.cleanedAlphaAtom.transposedAtom.commonSmoothWeight_nonneg m)
      rw [centeredRow_sub_truncated_eq_tail hd H hp m]
      have hrow : 0 ≤ CommonPM2FiniteFold.rowSum d p m := by
        unfold CommonPM2FiniteFold.rowSum
        exact Finset.sum_nonneg (fun _ _ => mul_nonneg (norm_nonneg _)
          (sq_nonneg _))
      have hs := (sq_le_sq₀ (norm_nonneg (tailRow d H p m))
        (div_nonneg hrow hH.le)).2 (tailRow_norm_le hd hH hp m)
      simpa only [div_pow] using hs
    _ = _ := by
      unfold CommonPM2FiniteFold.moment
      simp only [Finset.sum_div, mul_div_assoc]

end

def complexFactorModulus (r : ℕ × ℕ × ℕ) : ℕ := r.1 * r.2.1 * r.2.2

/-- The original complex factor coefficient, with no absolute value or
normalization by a number of factorizations. -/
def MediumAtom.complexFactorGamma (d : MediumAtom) (r : ℕ × ℕ × ℕ) : ℂ :=
  d.gamma1 r.1 * d.gamma2 r.2.1 * d.gamma3 r.2.2

def MediumAtom.complexFactorLabels (d : MediumAtom) : Finset (ℕ × ℕ × ℕ) :=
  factorCarrier d.Q1 ×ˢ (factorCarrier d.Q2 ×ˢ factorCarrier d.Q3)

/-- A complete factor label together with the original beta integer. -/
def MediumAtom.complexRowLabels (d : MediumAtom) : Finset ((ℕ × ℕ × ℕ) × ℕ) :=
  d.complexFactorLabels ×ˢ d.betaCarrier

/-- The literal arithmetic kernel of `MediumAtom.discrepancy`.
Finite identities also permit modulus zero under total division; actual
admissible carrier applications already have positive physical moduli. -/
def complexPrimitiveKernel (a : ℤ) (q n m : ℕ) : ℂ :=
  (if (((n * m : ℕ) : ℤ) % (q : ℤ) = a % (q : ℤ)) then 1 else 0) -
    (if (n * m).Coprime q then 1 else 0) / (Nat.totient q : ℂ)

def MediumAtom.complexRowContribution (d : MediumAtom) (n : ℕ)
    (l : (ℕ × ℕ × ℕ) × ℕ) : ℂ :=
  d.complexFactorGamma l.1 * d.beta l.2 *
    complexPrimitiveKernel d.residue (complexFactorModulus l.1) n l.2

/-- The full progression row before its primitive centre is subtracted. -/
def MediumAtom.complexProgressionRow (d : MediumAtom) (n : ℕ) : ℂ :=
  ∑ l ∈ d.complexRowLabels, d.complexFactorGamma l.1 * d.beta l.2 *
    (if (((n * l.2 : ℕ) : ℤ) % (complexFactorModulus l.1 : ℤ) =
      d.residue % (complexFactorModulus l.1 : ℤ)) then 1 else 0)

/-- The full primitive-coprime centre on the same labels and modulus. -/
def MediumAtom.complexPrincipalRow (d : MediumAtom) (n : ℕ) : ℂ :=
  ∑ l ∈ d.complexRowLabels,
    d.complexFactorGamma l.1 * d.beta l.2 *
      (if (n * l.2).Coprime (complexFactorModulus l.1) then 1 else 0) /
        (Nat.totient (complexFactorModulus l.1) : ℂ)

def MediumAtom.complexCenteredRow (d : MediumAtom) (n : ℕ) : ℂ :=
  d.complexProgressionRow n - d.complexPrincipalRow n

/-- A slice has original geometry; its new point mass is primitive. -/
theorem mediumAdmissible_q1SliceAtom
    {B : ℕ} {sigma kappa c0 : ℝ} {d : MediumAtom}
    (hd : MediumAdmissible B sigma kappa c0 d) {p : ℕ}
    (hp : p ∈ d.primitiveFirstFactorCarrier) :
    MediumAdmissible B sigma kappa c0 (d.q1SliceAtom p) := by
  obtain ⟨_hp, hpa⟩ := Finset.mem_filter.mp hp
  obtain ⟨hU, hV, hQ1, hQ2, hQ3, hx, ha0, ha1, hg1, hg2, hg3, hg4,
    hAlpha, hRough, hBeta, _hGamma1, hGamma2, hGamma3⟩ := hd
  refine ⟨hU, hV, hQ1, hQ2, hQ3, hx, ha0, ha1, hg1, hg2, hg3, hg4,
    hAlpha, hRough, hBeta, ?_, hGamma2, hGamma3⟩
  intro q _
  change ‖(if q = p then (1 : ℂ) else 0)‖ ≤ 1 ∧
    ((if q = p then (1 : ℂ) else 0) ≠ 0 → q.Coprime d.residue.natAbs)
  by_cases hqp : q = p
  · subst q
    constructor
    · simpa only [ite_true, norm_one] using (le_refl (1 : ℝ))
    · exact fun _ ↦ hpa
  · constructor
    · simpa only [if_neg hqp, norm_zero] using (zero_le_one : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 1)
    · intro hn
      exact (hn (if_neg hqp)).elim

private theorem slice_rows (d : MediumAtom) (p : ℕ) :
    (d.q1SliceAtom p).transposedAtom.complexRowLabels =
      d.transposedAtom.complexRowLabels := rfl

private theorem slice_coefficient (d : MediumAtom) (p : ℕ)
    (l : (ℕ × ℕ × ℕ) × ℕ) :
    (d.q1SliceAtom p).transposedAtom.complexBetaCoefficient l =
      (if l.1.1 = p then (1 : ℂ) else 0) *
        d.gamma2 l.1.2.1 * d.gamma3 l.1.2.2 * d.transposedAtom.beta l.2 := rfl

private theorem sum_slice_coefficient (d : MediumAtom) {p : ℕ}
    (hp : p ∈ factorCarrier d.Q1)
    (f : ((ℕ × ℕ × ℕ) × ℕ) → ℂ) :
    (∑ l ∈ (d.q1SliceAtom p).transposedAtom.complexRowLabels,
      (d.q1SliceAtom p).transposedAtom.complexBetaCoefficient l * f l) =
      ∑ l ∈ d.sharedFirstFactorRows,
        d.sharedFirstFactorCoefficient l * f ((p, l.1.1, l.1.2), l.2) := by
  rw [slice_rows]
  simp only [MediumAtom.complexRowLabels, MediumAtom.complexFactorLabels,
    MediumAtom.sharedFirstFactorRows, Finset.sum_product]
  change (∑ q ∈ factorCarrier d.Q1, ∑ q2 ∈ factorCarrier d.Q2,
    ∑ q3 ∈ factorCarrier d.Q3, ∑ n ∈ d.transposedAtom.betaCarrier,
      (d.q1SliceAtom p).transposedAtom.complexBetaCoefficient ((q, q2, q3), n) *

  rw [Finset.sum_eq_single p]
  · simp only [slice_coefficient, ite_true, one_mul,
      MediumAtom.sharedFirstFactorCoefficient]
  · intro q _ hqp
    simp only [slice_coefficient, if_neg hqp, zero_mul, Finset.sum_const_zero]
  · intro hnot
    exact (hnot hp).elim

def MediumAtom.transposedAtom (d : MediumAtom) : MediumAtom :=
  { d with
    U := d.V
    V := d.U
    intervalLo := -1
    intervalHi := (Nat.floor (2 * d.V) : ℝ)
    alpha := d.beta
    beta := fun n ↦ if n ∈ d.alphaCarrier then d.alpha n else 0 }

theorem MediumAtom.transposedAtom_betaCarrier (d : MediumAtom) :
    d.transposedAtom.betaCarrier = factorCarrier d.U := rfl

/-- Exact finite extension by zero of the original interval coefficient. -/
theorem MediumAtom.sum_transposedBeta_mul (d : MediumAtom) (f : ℕ → ℂ) :
    (∑ n ∈ d.transposedAtom.betaCarrier, d.transposedAtom.beta n * f n) =
      ∑ n ∈ d.alphaCarrier, d.alpha n * f n := by
  change (∑ n ∈ factorCarrier d.U,
    (if n ∈ d.alphaCarrier then d.alpha n else 0) * f n) = _
  simp only [ite_mul, zero_mul]
  rw [← Finset.sum_filter]
  have hsub : d.alphaCarrier ⊆ factorCarrier d.U := Finset.filter_subset _ _
  have heq : (factorCarrier d.U).filter (fun n ↦ n ∈ d.alphaCarrier) = d.alphaCarrier := by
    ext n
    simp only [Finset.mem_filter]
    exact ⟨fun h ↦ h.2, fun h ↦ ⟨hsub h, h⟩⟩
  rw [heq]

theorem mediumAdmissible_cleanedAlphaAtom
    {B : ℕ} {sigma kappa c0 : ℝ} {d : MediumAtom}
    (hd : MediumAdmissible B sigma kappa c0 d) :
    MediumAdmissible B sigma kappa c0 d.cleanedAlphaAtom := by
  obtain ⟨hU, hV, hQ1, hQ2, hQ3, hx, ha0, ha1, hg1, hg2, hg3, hg4,
    hAlpha, hRough, hBeta, hGamma1, hGamma2, hGamma3⟩ := hd
  refine ⟨hU, hV, hQ1, hQ2, hQ3, hx, ha0, ha1, hg1, hg2, hg3, hg4,
    ?_, ?_, hBeta, hGamma1, hGamma2, hGamma3⟩
  · intro n hn
    change ‖d.cleanedAlpha n‖ ≤ 1
    by_cases h : (n : ℤ) ∣ d.residue
    · simp only [MediumAtom.cleanedAlpha, if_pos h, norm_zero, zero_le_one]
    · simpa only [MediumAtom.cleanedAlpha, if_neg h] using hAlpha n hn
  · intro n hn hnz p hp hpn
    apply hRough n hn _ p hp hpn
    change d.cleanedAlpha n ≠ 0 at hnz
    by_cases h : (n : ℤ) ∣ d.residue
    · exact (hnz (by simp only [MediumAtom.cleanedAlpha, if_pos h])).elim
    · simpa only [MediumAtom.cleanedAlpha, if_neg h] using hnz

theorem MediumAtom.cleanedAlpha_ne_zero_not_dvd {d : MediumAtom} {n : ℕ}
    (hn : d.cleanedAlpha n ≠ 0) : ¬(n : ℤ) ∣ d.residue := by
  intro h
  exact hn (by simp only [MediumAtom.cleanedAlpha, if_pos h])

/-- This is the actual coefficient paired by the new dispersion. -/
theorem MediumAtom.cleanedAlpha_transposedBeta_ne_zero_not_dvd {d : MediumAtom} {n : ℕ}
    (hn : d.cleanedAlphaAtom.transposedAtom.beta n ≠ 0) : ¬(n : ℤ) ∣ d.residue := by
  change (if n ∈ d.alphaCarrier then d.cleanedAlpha n else 0) ≠ 0 at hn
  by_cases hm : n ∈ d.alphaCarrier
  · exact d.cleanedAlpha_ne_zero_not_dvd (by simpa only [if_pos hm] using hn)
  · exact (hn (by simp only [if_neg hm])).elim

def MediumAtom.cleanedCommonPProgression (d : MediumAtom) (p m : ℕ) : Finset ℕ :=
  d.cleanedAlphaAtom.transposedAtom.betaCarrier.filter
    (fun n => ¬(n : ℤ) ∣ d.residue ∧
      Int.ModEq p ((m : ℤ) * n) d.residue)

/-- Original outside energies occur exactly once. -/
def outsideEnergy (d : MediumAtom) : ℝ :=
  (∑ m ∈ d.betaCarrier, ‖d.beta m‖ ^ 2) *
    (∑ p ∈ d.primitiveFirstFactorCarrier, ‖d.gamma1 p‖ ^ 2)

def MediumAtom.absoluteFactorFiber (d : MediumAtom) (q : ℕ) : ℝ :=
  ∑ r ∈ d.physicalFactorFiber q, ‖d.complexFactorGamma r‖

private theorem gamma_norm_le_one
    {B : ℕ} {sigma kappa c0 : ℝ} {d : MediumAtom}
    (hd : MediumAdmissible B sigma kappa c0 d) {r : ℕ × ℕ × ℕ}
    (hr : r ∈ d.complexFactorLabels) : ‖d.complexFactorGamma r‖ ≤ 1 := by
  obtain ⟨_, _, _, _, _, _, _, _, _, _, _, _, _, _, _, h1, h2, h3⟩ := hd
  obtain ⟨hr1, hr23⟩ := Finset.mem_product.mp hr
  obtain ⟨hr2, hr3⟩ := Finset.mem_product.mp hr23
  rw [MediumAtom.complexFactorGamma, norm_mul, norm_mul]
  calc
    ‖d.gamma1 r.1‖ * ‖d.gamma2 r.2.1‖ * ‖d.gamma3 r.2.2‖ ≤ 1 * 1 * 1 :=
      mul_le_mul (mul_le_mul (h1 _ hr1).1 (h2 _ hr2).1 (norm_nonneg _) zero_le_one)
        (h3 _ hr3).1 (norm_nonneg _) (by norm_num)
    _ = 1 := by norm_num

theorem MediumAtom.absoluteFactorFiber_le_tauThree
    {B : ℕ} {sigma kappa c0 : ℝ} {d : MediumAtom}
    (hd : MediumAdmissible B sigma kappa c0 d) (q : ℕ) :
    d.absoluteFactorFiber q ≤ (fouvryTau 3 q : ℝ) := by
  calc
    _ ≤ ∑ _r ∈ d.physicalFactorFiber q, (1 : ℝ) :=
      Finset.sum_le_sum (fun r hr ↦ gamma_norm_le_one hd (Finset.mem_filter.mp hr).1)
    _ = ((d.physicalFactorFiber q).card : ℝ) := by simp
    _ ≤ _ := by exact_mod_cast d.card_physicalFactorFiber_le_tauThree hd q

def MediumAtom.absoluteFactorModulusRow (d : MediumAtom) (m n : ℕ) : ℝ :=
  ∑ r ∈ d.complexFactorLabels,
    if Int.ModEq (complexFactorModulus r) ((m : ℤ) * n) d.residue
      then ‖d.complexFactorGamma r‖ else 0

theorem MediumAtom.absoluteFactorModulusRow_nonneg (d : MediumAtom) (m n : ℕ) :
    0 ≤ d.absoluteFactorModulusRow m n := by
  apply Finset.sum_nonneg
  intro r _
  split_ifs <;> positivity

private theorem absoluteFactorModulusRow_eq_fibers (d : MediumAtom) (m n : ℕ) :
    d.absoluteFactorModulusRow m n = ∑ q ∈ d.physicalFactorModuli,
      if Int.ModEq q ((m : ℤ) * n) d.residue then d.absoluteFactorFiber q else 0 := by
  unfold MediumAtom.absoluteFactorModulusRow
  rw [← Finset.sum_fiberwise_of_maps_to
    (s := d.complexFactorLabels) (t := d.physicalFactorModuli)
    (g := complexFactorModulus) (fun r hr ↦ Finset.mem_image_of_mem _ hr)]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro q _
  by_cases hq : Int.ModEq q ((m : ℤ) * n) d.residue
  · rw [if_pos hq]
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro r hr
    simp only [(Finset.mem_filter.mp hr).2, if_pos hq]
  · rw [if_neg hq]
    apply Finset.sum_eq_zero
    intro r hr
    simp only [(Finset.mem_filter.mp hr).2, if_neg hq]

/-- The good coefficient pays the nonzero-difference gate before tau_4 is used. -/
theorem MediumAtom.absoluteFactorModulusRow_le_tauFour
    {B : ℕ} {sigma kappa c0 : ℝ} {d : MediumAtom}
    (hd : MediumAdmissible B sigma kappa c0 d) (m n : ℕ)
    (hn : d.cleanedBeta n ≠ 0) :
    d.absoluteFactorModulusRow m n ≤
      (fouvryTau 4 (((m : ℤ) * n - d.residue).natAbs) : ℝ) := by
  have hne : (m : ℤ) * n - d.residue ≠ 0 := by
    intro h
    exact (d.cleanedBeta_ne_zero_not_dvd hn) ⟨m, by nlinarith⟩
  rw [absoluteFactorModulusRow_eq_fibers]
  calc
    _ ≤ ∑ q ∈ d.physicalFactorModuli,
        if Int.ModEq q ((m : ℤ) * n) d.residue then (fouvryTau 3 q : ℝ) else 0 := by
      apply Finset.sum_le_sum
      intro q _
      split_ifs
      · exact d.absoluteFactorFiber_le_tauThree hd q
      · exact le_rfl
    _ = ∑ q ∈ d.physicalFactorModuli.filter
        (fun q : ℕ ↦ Int.ModEq q ((m : ℤ) * n) d.residue), (fouvryTau 3 q : ℝ) := by
      rw [Finset.sum_filter]
    _ ≤ ∑ q ∈ (((m : ℤ) * n - d.residue).natAbs).divisors,
        (fouvryTau 3 q : ℝ) := by
      apply Finset.sum_le_sum_of_subset_of_nonneg
      · intro q hq
        have he := (Finset.mem_filter.mp hq).2
        apply Nat.mem_divisors.mpr
        refine ⟨?_, Int.natAbs_ne_zero.mpr hne⟩
        have hdiv : (q : ℤ) ∣ (m : ℤ) * n - d.residue :=
          Int.modEq_iff_dvd.mp he.symm
        exact_mod_cast Int.natAbs_dvd_natAbs.mpr hdiv
      · intro _ _ _
        positivity
    _ = _ := by rw [show 4 = 3 + 1 from rfl, fouvryTau_succ, Nat.cast_sum]

def orderedThreeFactors (q : ℕ) : Finset (Σ _ : ℕ × ℕ, ℕ × ℕ) :=
  q.divisorsAntidiagonal.sigma (fun p ↦ p.2.divisorsAntidiagonal)

theorem card_orderedThreeFactors (q : ℕ) :
    (orderedThreeFactors q).card = fouvryTau 3 q := by
  have hcard (n : ℕ) : n.divisorsAntidiagonal.card = n.divisors.card := by
    rw [← Nat.map_div_right_divisors]
    exact Finset.card_map _
  calc
    _ = ∑ p ∈ q.divisorsAntidiagonal, p.2.divisors.card := by
      simp only [orderedThreeFactors, Finset.card_sigma, hcard]
    _ = ∑ n ∈ q.divisors, n.divisors.card :=
      Nat.sum_divisorsAntidiagonal' (fun _ n ↦ n.divisors.card)
    _ = _ := by rw [show 3 = 2 + 1 from rfl, fouvryTau_succ]; simp only [fouvryTau_two]

def tripleToConvolution (r : ℕ × ℕ × ℕ) : Σ _ : ℕ × ℕ, ℕ × ℕ :=
  ⟨(r.1, r.2.1 * r.2.2), (r.2.1, r.2.2)⟩

theorem tripleToConvolution_injective : Function.Injective tripleToConvolution := by
  intro r s h
  exact Prod.ext (congrArg (fun p ↦ p.1.1) h) (congrArg (fun p ↦ p.2) h)

theorem MediumAtom.card_physicalFactorFiber_le_tauThree
    {B : ℕ} {sigma kappa c0 : ℝ} {d : MediumAtom}
    (hd : MediumAdmissible B sigma kappa c0 d) (q : ℕ) :
    (d.physicalFactorFiber q).card ≤ fouvryTau 3 q := by
  rw [← FactorFiber.card_orderedThreeFactors]
  apply Finset.card_le_card_of_injOn FactorFiber.tripleToConvolution
  · intro r hr
    obtain ⟨hr, hq⟩ := Finset.mem_filter.mp hr
    obtain ⟨h1, h2, h3⟩ := factorLabel_mem hr
    obtain ⟨_, _, hQ1, hQ2, hQ3, _⟩ := hd
    have hp1 := (factorCarrier_bounds hQ1 h1).1
    have hp2 := (factorCarrier_bounds hQ2 h2).1
    have hp3 := (factorCarrier_bounds hQ3 h3).1
    apply Finset.mem_sigma.mpr
    refine ⟨Nat.mem_divisorsAntidiagonal.mpr ⟨?_, ?_⟩,
      Nat.mem_divisorsAntidiagonal.mpr ⟨rfl, (Nat.mul_pos hp2 hp3).ne'⟩⟩
    · simpa only [FactorFiber.tripleToConvolution, complexFactorModulus, mul_assoc] using hq
    · rw [← hq]
      exact (Nat.mul_pos (Nat.mul_pos hp1 hp2) hp3).ne'
  · exact FactorFiber.tripleToConvolution_injective.injOn

def MediumAdmissible (B : ℕ) (σ κ c0 : ℝ) (d : MediumAtom) : Prop :=
  1 ≤ d.U ∧ 1 ≤ d.V ∧ 1 ≤ d.Q1 ∧ 1 ≤ d.Q2 ∧ 1 ≤ d.Q3 ∧
  Real.exp (Real.exp 1) < d.scale ∧
  c0 * d.scale ≤ (d.residue.natAbs : ℝ) ∧
  (d.residue.natAbs : ℝ) ≤ d.scale ^ (1 + κ) ∧
  d.Q1 < d.U * d.scale ^ (-σ) ∧
  d.U ^ 2 * d.Q2 * d.Q3 ^ 2 < d.scale ^ (1 - 8 * σ) ∧
  (d.residue.natAbs : ℝ) ^ (7 / 32 : ℝ) * d.U * d.Q1 * d.Q2 ^ 5 * d.Q3 ^ 2 <
    d.scale ^ (2 - 15 * σ) ∧
  d.U ^ (1 + 2 * (7 / 32 : ℝ)) * d.Q1 *
      d.Q2 ^ (5 - 2 * (7 / 32 : ℝ)) * d.Q3 ^ (2 + 2 * (7 / 32 : ℝ)) <
    d.scale ^ (2 - 15 * σ) ∧
  (∀ n ∈ d.alphaCarrier, ‖d.alpha n‖ ≤ 1) ∧
  (∀ n ∈ d.alphaCarrier, d.alpha n ≠ 0 → ∀ p : ℕ,
    Nat.Prime p → p ∣ n →
      d.scale ^ (1 / (Real.log (Real.log d.scale)) ^ 3) < (p : ℝ)) ∧
  (∀ m ∈ d.betaCarrier, ‖d.beta m‖ ≤ (m.divisors.card : ℝ) ^ B) ∧
  (∀ q ∈ factorCarrier d.Q1, ‖d.gamma1 q‖ ≤ 1 ∧
    (d.gamma1 q ≠ 0 → Nat.Coprime q d.residue.natAbs)) ∧
  (∀ q ∈ factorCarrier d.Q2, ‖d.gamma2 q‖ ≤ 1 ∧
    (d.gamma2 q ≠ 0 → Nat.Coprime q d.residue.natAbs)) ∧
  (∀ q ∈ factorCarrier d.Q3, ‖d.gamma3 q‖ ≤ 1 ∧
    (d.gamma3 q ≠ 0 → Nat.Coprime q d.residue.natAbs))

theorem fouvryTau_succ (k n : ℕ) :

theorem prod_filter (p : ι → Prop) [DecidablePred p] (f : ι → M) :
    ∏ a ∈ s with p a, f a = ∏ a ∈ s, if p a then f a else 1 :=
  calc
    ∏ a ∈ s with p a, f a = ∏ a ∈ s with p a, if p a then f a else 1 :=
      prod_congr rfl fun a h => by rw [if_pos]; simpa using (mem_filter.1 h).2
